units.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers

abilities.name: Fount of Willpower
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a friendly **^^Isharann^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Remove 1 of this unit's **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.

abilities.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul-quota token**.

abilities.name: Empowered by Memory
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm

weapons.name: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

abilities.name: Drench With Hate
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Crashing Upon the Foe
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Pulled Into the Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's** Allopex's Ferocious Bite** while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: Ensnared
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea

abilities.name: Dormant Energies
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Vengeful Waves
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.

weapons.name: Deepmare's Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: Wave Rider
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Akhelian Royal Weapons** for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Crest of the Wave
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.

units.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

weapons.name: Uasall's Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: First Among Akhelians
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **^^Akhelian^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Cealith, the High King's Shield
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (3+)^^** against mortal damage inflicted by **^^Spell^^** abilities, **^^Prayer^^** abilities or abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.
***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units.
***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **^^Retreat^^** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: Finder of Ways
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability or the 'Steed of Tides' ability
abilities.effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **^^Namarti^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Galv-shields
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Blast
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

weapons.name: Leviadon's Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Leviadon's Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws** is 5.

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Void Drum
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Namarti Thralls** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **^^Namarti^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **^^Fight^^** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Strike On the Move
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Rise from the Depths
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: This ability must be used instead of the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability.
abilities.effect:
Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.
If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Deep
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ruin
abilities.effect:
Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Surging Sea
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Rapid Approach
abilities.effect: This unit can use a **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn

abilities.name: Siren Song of The Abyss
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' **Companion** weapons.

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.effect:
Enemy units cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
Friendly units that use a **^^Retreat^^** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.
No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units by **^^Retreat^^** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the target is **^^Namarti^^**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an **^^Isharann^^** ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.
***Torrent of Blows*:** Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (2 Hits)**.
***Protection of the Waves*:** While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
***Frenzy of the Ethersea*:** For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Merciless Hunters
abilities.timing:
Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for
this unit
abilities.effect:
After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Concealing Tide
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units that did not use any **^^Charge^^** abilities in the same turn.

abilities.name: Swift Tide
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the 'Concealing Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units can use **^^Run^^** abilities and still use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Sea's Embrace
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the 'Swift Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round.
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units have **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Unpredictable Tide
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round. Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Inexorable Tide
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Storm's Wrath
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the 'Inexorable Tide' ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **^^Tidal^^** abilities this round.
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units' melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Twin Tides
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn(Army), Reaction: You declared an Attack ability for a friendly **^^Akhelian^^** unit
abilities.effect:
Pick a visible friendly **^^Namarti^^** unit that has not used an **^^Attack^^** ability this phase to be the target.
• If this unit used a **^^Shoot^^** ability, immediately after the **^^Shoot^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **^^Shoot^^** ability as if it were your shooting phase.
• If this unit used a **^^Fight^^** ability, immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit's attacks.

abilities.name: Lifekelp Pod
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Cavalry^^** unit within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Dritchleech
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit

abilities.name: Armour of the Cythai
abilities.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Fade Like Mist
abilities.effect: When using the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: Surge Forward
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Namarti^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Akhelian^^** unit.

abilities.name: Wisdom of the Deep
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **^^Isharann^^** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **^^Isharann^^** units

abilities.name: Ferocious Predators
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **^^Akhelian^^** units.

abilities.name: Form of the Fangmora
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Nightmare Legacy
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Hunter of Souls
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit's melee weapons to have
this battle:
• **Anti-^^Cavalry^^ (+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-^^Infantry^^(+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-^^Monster^^(+1 Rend)**

abilities.name: Endless Sea-Storm
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is a **^^Wizard^^**, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it gains **^^Wizard (1)^^** for the rest of the turn.
In addition, add 2 to the next casting roll or banishment roll for this unit this turn.

abilities.name: Merciless Raider
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is within 6" of a damaged enemy unit, this unit can move 6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit.

abilities.name: Lord of Storm and Sea
abilities.effect: Each time an ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

abilities.name: Abyssal Dweller
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, those units cannot use **^^Run^^**, **^^Retreat^^** or **^^Charge^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Cursed Lineage
abilities.timing: End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent's **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. 
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Counter-current
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Pressure of the Deep
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Steed of Tides
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ironshell Barnacles
abilities.effect:
If this unit is **^^Infantry^^**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.
• If this unit is **^^Cavalry^^**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.
• If this unit is a **^^Monster^^**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.

abilities.name: Stonefoot Anemone
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **^^Fight^^** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit's combat range must target this unit.
**Designer's Note:** *This ability does not override the* **^^Strike-first^^** *or* **^^Strike-last^^** *constraints.*
